title.zh: 修正第619号法第十一节的法案，该法题为《促进菲律宾保安队良好秩序与纪律的法案》，以规定被控人若于一年内经简易法庭三次定罪，可被判不名誉退伍并没收全部应得或将来应得薪俸与津贴，且不影响法律规定的其他处罚
title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND SECTION ELEVEN OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETEEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT TO PROMOTE GOOD ORDER AND DISCIPLINE IN THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY," SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT WHERE THE ACCUSED HAS BEEN CONVICTED BY SUMMARY COURT THREE TIMES WITHIN A YEAR HE MAY BE SENTENCED TO BE DISHONORABLY DISCHARGED AND TO FORFEIT ALL PAY AND ALLOWANCES DUE OR TO BECOME DUE, IN ADDITION TO ANY OTHER PENALTY PROVIDED BY LAW.
title.orig: AN ACT TO AMEND SECTION ELEVEN OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND NINETEEN, ENTITLED "AN ACT TO PROMOTE GOOD ORDER AND DISCIPLINE IN THE PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY," SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT WHERE THE ACCUSED HAS BEEN CONVICTED BY SUMMARY COURT THREE TIMES WITHIN A YEAR HE MAY BE SENTENCED TO BE DISHONORABLY DISCHARGED AND TO FORFEIT ALL PAY AND ALLOWANCES DUE OR TO BECOME DUE, IN ADDITION TO ANY OTHER PENALTY PROVIDED BY LAW.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 11 của Đạo luật số 619 về việc thúc đẩy trật tự và kỷ luật trong Cảnh sát Philippines nhằm quy định rằng người bị kết án ba lần trong một năm bởi Tòa án Tóm lược có thể bị tuyên bố xuất ngũ không danh dự và bị tịch thu toàn bộ lương và phụ cấp đã hoặc sẽ được hưởng, ngoài các hình phạt khác theo quy định pháp luật
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขมาตรา 11 แห่งพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 619 เรื่องการส่งเสริมระเบียบวินัยที่ดีในกองกำลังตำรวจฟิลิปปินส์เพื่อกำหนดว่าผู้ถูกกล่าวหาที่ถูกพิพากษาลงโทษโดยศาลสรุปสามครั้งภายในหนึ่งปีอาจถูกตัดสินให้ออกจากราชการอย่างไม่มีเกียรติและสูญเสียเงินเดือนและเงินประจำตำแหน่งทั้งหมดที่ได้รับหรือจะได้รับเพิ่มเติมจากบทลงโทษอื่นใดตามกฎหมาย
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 11 Undang-Undang Nomor 619 tentang Mendorong Ketertiban dan Disiplin yang Baik dalam Kepolisian Filipina guna menetapkan bahwa apabila terdakwa dihukum oleh Pengadilan Ringkas tiga kali dalam satu tahun, ia dapat dijatuhi hukuman pemecatan tidak hormat serta kehilangan seluruh gaji dan tunjangan yang telah atau akan menjadi haknya, selain hukuman lain sebagaimana diatur undang-undang
title.ms: Akta mengubah Seksyen 11 Akta Nombor 619 bertajuk Akta untuk Mempromosikan Ketertiban dan Disiplin yang Baik dalam Polis Filipina bagi menetapkan bahawa jika tertuduh telah dihukum oleh Mahkamah Ringkas sebanyak tiga kali dalam masa setahun, beliau boleh dihukum penyingkiran secara tidak bermaruah dan kehilangan semua gaji dan elaun yang telah atau akan menjadi haknya, selain daripada hukuman lain yang ditetapkan oleh undang-undang

text.en:
Section eleven of Act Numbered Six hundred and nineteen, entitled "An Act to promote good
order and discipline in the Philippines Constabulary" is hereby amended by inserting in the eighteenth line of
said section, after the word "discharged" and before the words "in addition to the penalties herein before
mentioned," the following words: ''and to forfeit all pay and allowances due or to become due," so that the
proviso in which said insertion occurs shall read as follows: "Provided, That where the accused is a non-
commissioned officer or a first-class private, he may be sentenced to reduction to the grade of second-class
private in addition thereto, and that where the accused has been convicted by summary court three times
within a year he may be sentenced to be dishonorably discharged and to forfeit all pay and allowances due or
to become due, in addition to the penalties herein before mentioned."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 20, 1904.
